title: Slow magnetic relaxation in four square-based pyramidal dysprosium hydroxo clusters ligated by chiral amino acid anions – a comparative study

synthesis.procedure: General procedure for 1–4: D-PhGlyH (322 mg, 2.12 mmol, 0.8 eq.) was dissolved in a stirred solution of KOtBu (893 mg, 7.96 mmol, 3 eq.) in 20 mL methanol. Ph2acacH (714 mg, 3.18 mmol, 1.2 eq.) was added, turning the colourless solution yellow. After 15 min stirring, [DyCl3·(H2O)6] (1.00 g, 2.65 mmol, 1 eq.) in 20 mL methanol was added dropwise, forming a flaky white precipitate. The mixture was stirred overnight at room temperature; the precipitate was filtered off, washed with methanol (3 × 5 mL) and air-dried. The yellow solid of 1 was extracted with 5 mL dichloromethane, filtered, cooled to −80 °C and layered with 20 mL n-hexane, giving yellow single crystals after 1–4 days.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature overnight; crystallization at −80 °C then layered with n-hexane
synthesis.time: 15 min after Ph2acacH addition; overnight stirring; crystals after 1–4 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred methanolic self-assembly; air-dried precipitate extracted with CH2Cl2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: precipitate filtered, washed with MeOH (3 × 5 mL), air-dried; extracted with 5 mL CH2Cl2, filtered, cooled to −80 °C and layered with 20 mL n-hexane

properties.summary: Dc χT ≈ 70.0 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature (expected 70.85 for five uncoupled Dy(III)); χT decreases on cooling, consistent with dominant antiferromagnetic interactions and/or thermal depopulation of Dy Stark sublevels. Ac data show frequency-dependent χ′ and χ″ below 10 K without maxima, consistent with SMM behaviour and a blocking temperature below 1.8 K with fast zero-field QTM. Applied small dc fields still leave relaxation outside the 1.8 K experimental window, so no energy barrier or τ0 could be extracted. χ′:χ″ intensity ratio about 4:1.
